decision: The terminal artifacts prove the endpoint result but cannot causally allocate its 0.826414-second contextual wall-time difference among decode layers, prefill, output head, scheduler, or intervention overhead. No residual work family is nominated and decode-layer work is not broadly closed by these artifacts.

comparability.same_endpoint_geometry: cache-off, 8192 input, 1024 output, c16, max_num_seqs=16, max_num_batched_tokens=65536, num_kv_splits=4
comparability.control_identity: contextual, not adjacent; the exit project explicitly disallows treating it as an adjacent control

attribution_assessment.prefill: not separately timed in either c16/1024 request profile; fixed 8192-token prefill may dilute decode savings
attribution_assessment.decode_layers: patch evidence verifies full prefill and 35-layer decode, but no c16/1024 phase-bounded decode wall-time interval exists
attribution_assessment.output_head: no endpoint-bound head interval or counter exists
attribution_assessment.scheduler_queue: server metrics provide aggregate queue and TTFT sums only; they do not partition endpoint wall time
attribution_assessment.intervention_overhead: no matched stock/exit phase timing or instrumentation isolates patch overhead
attribution_assessment.trace_exclusion: both retained profiler artifacts are fixed_8k_128_c8 (8 requests, 128 outputs, c8), so their kernel intervals are out of scope for the fixed_8k_1k_c16 endpoint and cannot be converted into wall-time shares

stress_cases.sampling: The 32 rows are correlated members of a c16 batch schedule, so row resampling would not estimate aggregate wall-time uncertainty. Sorted eight-row mean end-to-end clusters span 29.226-30.107 seconds for r3 and 29.171-29.332 seconds for exit35.
stress_cases.contextual_control: The observed 1.4123% difference is a contextual run-to-run contrast, not a randomized adjacent control.
stress_cases.overlap_or_replacement: Without target-geometry phase ranges, skipped layer work could have been overlapped, hidden by prefill, or replaced by a different bottleneck. Summed kernel durations would not resolve this.

resolving_measurement: One matched alternating stock-versus-exit35 c16, cache-off 8192/1024 run with request-bound NVTX ranges for prefill, decode, final norm/head, and scheduler wait, reported as interval-union wall time; no such measurement is prepared or run by this project.
